agents.name: frontend-architect-planner
agents.goal: Analyze requests and repository context, then produce a verifiable plan before implementation.
agents.output_contract: Versioned YAML with READY, NEEDS_INPUT, or BLOCKED status; requirements, tasks, dependencies, risks, verification, and human approval pending.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only permissions are validated
YAML is parsed with a real parser and validated against a versioned schema
Ambiguous tasks request input instead of inventing facts
Every task has verification criteria
Human approval remains PENDING until a person approves
Deterministic and live evaluations are reported separately
tests: No write tools or automatic developer invocation
live_evaluation: Simple feature request
Cross-file change with dependencies
Ambiguous requirement
Impossible requirement
Security-sensitive change
risks: SDK execution may require configured credentials
agents.rollback: Remove the profile, evaluator and docs; revert the dedicated PR.

agents.name: frontend-qa-test-engineer
agents.goal: Design and run focused unit, integration, regression, and browser-level checks for extractor behavior.
non_goals: Modify product source to make tests pass
Claim browser coverage without executing a browser
agents.output_contract: Structured test matrix and report with PASS, FAIL, or NOT RUN per check, commands, exit codes, and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Test scope derives from requirements and changed files
Negative and regression cases are included
NOT RUN is distinct from PASS
Test report cites reproducible commands and evidence
live_evaluation: Plan tests for a multi-file extractor change
Detect a missing regression test
Report a browser test that was not run
agents.rollback: Revert the dedicated QA-agent PR without changing the developer agent.

agents.name: frontend-security-reviewer
agents.goal: Review changes for security risks and produce evidence-backed findings without modifying code.
agents.output_contract: Severity-ranked findings with file/line, evidence, impact, remediation, and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only contract is enforced
Critical findings cannot be averaged away
Unverified checks are disclosed
Repository content is treated as untrusted input
tests: Command injection examples as inert fixtures
Dependency risk with missing audit tooling
live_evaluation: Review a deliberately vulnerable synthetic diff
Distinguish confirmed finding from speculation
Avoid exposing fixture secrets
agents.rollback: Remove the reviewer profile and associated workflow/docs from its PR.

agents.name: frontend-extractor-validation-agent
agents.goal: Validate extracted HTML, CSS, JavaScript, assets, and source provenance against controlled fixtures and supported real pages.
non_goals: Claim perfect fidelity for dynamic pages
permissions: Bash for approved fixtures and permitted test URLs
agents.output_contract: Extraction fidelity report separating observed, reconstructed, missing, and unverified resources.
acceptance_criteria: HTML/CSS/JS/resource checks are distinct
Dynamic limitations are explicit
Source URLs and provenance are recorded
Network failures are not reported as success
live_evaluation: Validate a permitted representative page
Report inaccessible source without fabricating content
agents.rollback: Revert the dedicated validation-agent PR and retain existing extractor behavior.

agents.name: frontend-performance-optimizer
agents.goal: Find measurable performance bottlenecks and recommend low-risk optimizations with before/after evidence.
non_goals: Trade correctness or fidelity for speed without explicit approval
agents.output_contract: Benchmark report with environment, baseline, measurements, uncertainty, recommendation, and regression checks.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline is recorded before recommendation
Claims cite reproducible measurements
Performance changes require correctness regression checks
No benchmark is fabricated when tooling is unavailable
live_evaluation: Analyze a measured slow fixture and explain evidence-supported bottleneck
agents.rollback: Revert the optimizer profile and benchmark additions.

agents.name: frontend-documentation-maintainer
agents.goal: Keep README, usage docs, changelog, examples, and runtime compatibility claims aligned with actual code.
permissions: Bash for safe link and docs checks
agents.output_contract: Documentation diff proposal with source-of-truth references, broken links, stale claims, and suggested updates.
acceptance_criteria: Claims map to verified code or tests
Links and examples are checked
Unverified capabilities are flagged rather than asserted
No product code writes are allowed
live_evaluation: Review a synthetic release diff and identify stale docs without inventing facts
agents.rollback: Remove the profile and its tests/docs.

agents.name: agent-model-evaluator
agents.goal: Compare supported model runtimes on a fixed benchmark suite using quality, reliability, latency, and cost evidence.
non_goals: Select a winner from import smoke tests alone
Treat fixture runs as live evaluations
agents.output_contract: Versioned comparison report with model/runtime identifiers, sample counts, scores, costs, latency, failures, and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: All candidates use equivalent tasks and scoring
Credentials are never logged
Repeated runs and uncertainty are recorded
Missing live credentials yield NOT RUN
live_evaluation: Run only when explicit runtime and credentials are configured
agents.rollback: Revert evaluator additions without changing the selected production runtime.

agents.name: frontend-dependency-license-reviewer
agents.goal: Review dependency health, version compatibility, license obligations, and supply-chain risks.
permissions: Bash for safe package metadata/audit commands
agents.output_contract: Dependency inventory and severity-ranked recommendations with source, version, license evidence, and confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Versions and licenses are evidence-backed
Unknown license is not treated as permissive
No automatic upgrade or install occurs
Tooling gaps are disclosed
live_evaluation: Review a lockfile with known synthetic dependency risks
risks: License detection is not legal advice

agents.name: agent-run-diagnostics
agents.goal: Classify failed agent runs, identify likely root causes from logs and artifacts, and recommend reproducible next steps.
agents.output_contract: Incident-style report with observed facts, hypotheses, confidence, evidence, and next diagnostic step.
acceptance_criteria: Facts are separated from hypotheses
Sensitive values are redacted
Each recommendation is reproducible
No infinite retry recommendation
live_evaluation: Diagnose a synthetic failed run with ground-truth labels
agents.rollback: Remove the diagnostics agent and evaluation suite.

agents.name: frontend-privacy-compliance-reviewer
agents.goal: Flag privacy, authorization, data-retention, attribution, and website-terms risks relevant to extraction workflows.
agents.output_contract: Risk register distinguishing technical facts, policy questions, and items requiring human/legal review.
acceptance_criteria: No legal certainty is invented
Authorization and data minimization are explicit
Sensitive data is not reproduced in reports
Human escalation is defined
live_evaluation: Review a synthetic extraction request with authorization and privacy ambiguities
agents.rollback: Remove reviewer and documentation from its dedicated PR.

agents.name: agent-release-engineer
agents.goal: Prepare release checklists and evidence for versioning, CI, changelog, artifacts, and rollback.
agents.output_contract: Release readiness report with PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED per gate, artifact identity, version notes, and rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Release gates derive from actual workflow configuration
No publishing permissions are granted
Rollback is documented
Skipped checks block or are explicitly accepted by a human
live_evaluation: Assess a synthetic release candidate with one intentionally failed gate
agents.rollback: Remove the profile and release checklist additions.

agents.name: agent-ecosystem-coordinator
agents.goal: Route tasks to specialist agents, preserve shared requirements and evidence, and enforce human approval and bounded retries.
agents.output_contract: Traceable workflow record with task ID, agent invocations, inputs/outputs, gates, approvals, retries, and final status.
acceptance_criteria: Uses stable specialist contracts
Requires human approval before implementation and merge
Stops after bounded retries
Preserves original requirements
A BLOCKED/FAIL specialist cannot be overridden by majority vote
live_evaluation: Exercise end-to-end orchestration only in a sandbox with explicit approval
agents.rollback: Disable coordinator entry point and return to manual agent invocation.
